_about: «بعد الصلاة» on the tasbih screen (reply 0032 D-6; Talal 22:58): the steps cut verbatim from HadeethEnc hadith 10948 (diacritics removed on both sides for the check in worker/test/daily-data.test.ts; the screen shows the words with the source's own diacritics, cut from the text at run time). Each step: the words, how many times, and the words of the hadith that give the number.

_alt: The other narration of the session on the lock screen (add-on 0072-add19 §3): HadeethEnc hadith 6259 (Ka'b ibn 'Ujrah, sahih, narrated by Muslim): after every obligatory prayer, 33 tasbihas, 33 tahmidas and 34 takbiras. Each step's words and number are verbatim in its text (worker/test/alerts-0072.test.ts).
_words: The tasbih screen's chips: each cut verbatim from a sahih hadith's text at run time (5475: the four words most beloved to Allah; 10947: the istighfar after prayer as al-Awza'i described it). `phrase` locates it in the text; `cut` is the part shown when the text joins it with «و».
